correctness.rationale: For odd b>=3 and integer k>(b+1)/2, translation by (1/2,1/2) makes a right triangle with legs d/2,d/b, d=k-(b+1)/2, so area=(2k-b-1)^2/(16b). No facet has an integer point. Exactly I=sum_{j=0}^{q-1} floor((b j+r)/2) interior points for k=bq+r,0<=r<b. Because b odd, parity of bj+r is parity of j+r; the explicit count of odd terms yields Delta=(2r-b-1)^2/(16b) plus 0 if q even, -1/4 if q odd r even, +1/4 if q odd r odd. Minimizing the even r square gives -1/4 if b=3 mod4 and -(b-1)/(4b) if b=1 mod4, with stated exhaustive residues; maximizing gives (b+1)^2/(16b) with q even r=0 or q odd r=1. The negative criterion is q odd,r even and |2r-b-1|<2 sqrt(b). Independent exact rational enumeration tested 13161 admissible parameter pairs and sign/extrema. The universal proof uses exact finite row summation, not finite enumeration.
